gripOrHq.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

gripOrHq.title: R&D Mole
gripOrHq.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from R&D. Use this ability only when accessing cards from R&D. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Security Code WORM Chip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Security Code WORM Chip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Trash a piece of unrezzed ice.

rig.title: Highlighter
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

ice.title: Data Raven
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag and a Data Raven counter. Each Data Raven counter gives Runner a tag at the start of each Runner turn. Runner may remove a Data Raven counter by taking an action to pay [1].

root.title: Punitive Counterstrike
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 2 meat damage.

root.title: Netwatch Credit Voucher
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Give Runner 1 tag and gain [1].

root.title: Chance Observation
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

root.title: Omniscience Foundation
root.rulesText: Give Runner a tag at the end of each turn during which Runner received a tag.
